recap.analyst:
Navigli United and Thames Rovers drew 1-1. On expected goals it finished 1.62–0.06: Navigli United did enough to win on chances and will feel they dropped points.

Thames Rovers had 55% of the ball. Pass completion NAV 77% (144/188), TRV 79% (168/212). Shots 13–1, on target 1–1.

Navigli United started in a 4-2-3-1 (direct), Thames Rovers in a 5-4-1 (direct). In-game changes: NAV to 4-2-3-1 at 66' (chasing the game); TRV to 5-4-1 at 79' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 94': Navigli United levelled the match through B. Olalagu. The chance was worth xG 0.23 (about 23 in 100 go in), struck at 93 km/h. Score now NAV 1-1 TRV.

By the numbers: P. Dralav completed the most passes (44); B. Stansevic hit the top speed (30.9 km/h); E. Navvena covered the most ground (6.2 km, a 17.8 km per-90 pace); B. Olalagu won the most challenges (18).

Discipline: fouls 1–4, yellows 1–1, offsides 1–0. Conditions: overcast, 26°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Arena Lombarda, Milan. N. Engoberg broke the deadlock in the 9th minute. B. Olalagu struck in the 94th for Navigli United. Thames Rovers had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: N. Engoberg, with the goal that mattered. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
